notes.trinkets: There are a great number of Trinkets available for Subtlety, and we will always want to play a combination of a powerful on-use trinket to align with our Shadow Blades , and there are two of those this season: Voracious Heart of Ula'tek and Freightrunner's Flask . Alongside that on-use we want a passive trinket providing potent secondary stat buffs or raw damage procs.
